neighboringSourceContext.speaker: Sam Harris
neighboringSourceContext.claimSummary: Specific doctrines can be indispensable explanations of particular religious conduct even though religion also includes ritual, belonging, and transcendence.
neighboringSourceContext.reasonSummary: ISIS's prescribed treatment of gay people follows a particular rule book, while other traditions generate different specific practices.

inferenceSummary.premise: Distinct religious traditions explicitly prescribe distinct, otherwise highly specific behaviors.
inferenceSummary.inference: When behavior varies with those prescriptions and lacks a comparably specific intuitive source, doctrine has causal explanatory force.
inferenceSummary.conclusion: A complete account of religious moral conduct must take specific beliefs seriously.
